set -Eeuo pipefail
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0

python3 - <<'PY'
import os,subprocess,shutil,sys,time
root=os.getcwd()
tests=[
('AST_SYNTAX_CHECK',[sys.executable,'-c','import ast,subprocess,pathlib; files=[pathlib.Path(x) for x in subprocess.check_output(["git","ls-files"],text=True).splitlines() if x.endswith(".py")]; [ast.parse(x.read_text(),filename=str(x)) for x in files]; print("AST_FILES",len(files))']),
('CODEX_TESTS',[sys.executable,'-m','unittest','discover','-s','codex/tests','-t','.','-p','test_*.py','-q']),
('CONTROL_TESTS',[sys.executable,'-m','unittest','discover','-s','tests','-t','.','-p','test_*.py','-q']),
('GIT_DIFF_CHECK',['git','--no-pager','diff','--check'])
]
fail=0
for name,cmd in tests:
 t=time.monotonic()
 try:
  q=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=root,env={**os.environ,'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1','GIT_PAGER':'cat'},text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=125)
  print('TEST',name,'exit',q.returncode,'seconds',round(time.monotonic()-t,2),flush=True)
  if q.stdout:print('STDOUT',name,q.stdout[-2500:],flush=True)
  if q.stderr:print('STDERR',name,q.stderr[-5000:],flush=True)
  if q.returncode:fail+=1
 except Exception as e:fail+=1;print('TEST_EXCEPTION',name,type(e).__name__,str(e)[:250],flush=True)
print('CODEX_BINARY',shutil.which('codex') or 'NOT_FOUND')
print('GIT_STATUS',repr(subprocess.run(['git','status','--porcelain'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout[:1000]))
print('AUDIT_TESTS_FAILED',fail,flush=True)
sys.exit(1 if fail else 0)
PY
